pr_title: sessionctx/variable: allow -1 value of executor's variables if rollback from master branch
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #20124, close #18910 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary:

see #20124

### What is changed and how it works?

In https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/15428, we incorporate several variables controlling executors' concurrency into `tidb_executor_concurrency` and make the old default to -1. 
After that change, when rollback from master to v4.0.X, v4.0.X cannot accept -1 of these variables.

Proposal: [xxx](url) <!-- REMOVE this line if not applicable -->

What's Changed:

Allow -1 for these values.

issue_context.title: Rollback from master to v4.0.X got Variable 'tidb_index_lookup_concurrency' can't be set to the value of '-1'

## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

1. set up a v4.0.X cluster, start tidb-server
2. upgrade to master version(the future v5.0.0), restart tidb-server
3. rollback to the original v4.0.X version, restart tidb-server

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

tidb-server starts normally.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

It gets the error message Variable 'tidb_index_lookup_concurrency' can't be set to the value of '-1' and fails to start.
